title: CLCON/170/2015 of Dabal Singh Rawat Vs Harshendra Kumar Singh

paras.text:
I.A. No. 3061 of 2020 (Misc. Application)
In
CLCON No. 170 of 2015
Hon'ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.

Mr. Parikshit Saini, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. H.M. Raturi, Mr. Vinod Nautiyal,
Mrs. Mamta Bisht, Deputy Advocate
General, Mr. R.C. Arya, Mr. S.K. Mishra
and Mr. Pradeep Hariya, Standing Counsel,
Mr. Gajendra Tripathi, Mr. J.S. Bisht, Mr.
Atul Bahuguna, Mr. M.S. Bisht & Mr. V.S.
Rawat, Brief Holder for the State of
Uttarakhand.
Heard learned counsel for the parties
through video conferencing.
Response affidavit filed on behalf of
the respondent is taken on record. The
misc. application, made therefor, stands
disposed of.
Writ Petition (PIL) No. 110 of 2014
filed by the petitioner was disposed of by a
Division Bench of this Court vide order
dated 28.08.2014. Operative portion of the
said order is extracted below:
"The DFO, Haridwar assisted by the
Surveyor of the Forest Department and the
officer nominated by the District
Magistrate, Haridwar assisted by the Tehsil
Surveyor will conduct a joint inspection to
go into the complaint of the petitioner that
there is an encroachment by the Forest
Department as alleged and the survey will
be completed within a period of three
months from the date of production of a
copy of this judgment before the District
Magistrate, Haridwar and if it is found that
there is encroachment, appropriate action
will be taken to remove the encroachment."

This Contempt Petition has been
filed by the petitioner alleging willful
disobedience of the said order.
A response affidavit has been filed by
Mr. Ashish Chandra Ghildiyal, Tehsildar,
Haridwar. Paragraph no. 4 of the said
affidavit is extracted below:
"4. That pursuant to the aforesaid
direction of the Hon'ble Court, the District
Magistrate, Haridwar vide its letter dated
29-11-2019 called upon the Sub
Divisional Magistrate, Haridwar and
Divisional Forest Officer, Haridwar Forest
Division, Haridwar to ensure the
compliance of the Hon'ble Court's
direction. In pursuance thereof, the Sub
Divisional Magistrate, Haridwar vide its
letter dated 12-02-2020 submitted before
the District Magistrate, Haridwar that vide
office order dated 05-12-2019 constituted
a committee of Revenue Department in
view of Assistance to be done with the
Team constituted by the Forest
Department for conducting the joint
inspection. It has been further narrated
therein that a joint inspection being done
by the joint committee and after the joint
inspection a report was prepared, wherein
para 6 thereof, it has been categorically
mentioned that the forest department has
installed pillars at the boundaries of
Village Jaspur Chamaria and further
narrated therein that land bearing Khasra
no. 12/2, 12/3, 12/5, 12/7 & 12/9
earmarked as a under category-1ka with
transferable right, total land admeasuring
5.994 hectare, out of which land
admeasuring 2.5197 hectare land was
under the possession of the Forest
Department. The Forest Department
installed pillars at spot from pillar no. 31
to 49, consequently the land of tenure
holders possessed by the Forest
Department has been vacated as such
there is no interference or possession of

the Forest Department over the aforesaid
land. In this connection a true/correct
typed version/photocopy of the later dated
12-02-2020 and joint inspection report
dated 07-02-2020 is being annexed
herewith and marked as Annexure-l to
this affidavit."
In view of the stand taken by
Tehsildar, Haridwar in his affidavit that the
land of the tenure holder, which was found
to be in possession of the Forest
Department has been vacated and Forest
Department has erected boundary pillars
over its land, nothing survives in this
Contempt Petition.
Accordingly, Contempt Petition is
dismissed.
Contempt notices issued to the
respondents are hereby discharged.
Learned counsel for the petitioner
submitted that possession of the land has
not been handed over to the tenure holders
so far.
If that is so, petitioner shall be at
liberty to approach the appropriate forum
for ventilation of his grievance, if any.
